{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|By the Bloody Bones, I swear I will be true and loyal to you or forfeit will be my life.|Rav swears to [[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 23">[[Legacy (2006) 23|''Legacy'' (2006) 23]]</ref>}}
When someone was admitted to [[Rav]]'s crew, he had him/her scribed with the mark of the [[Bloody Bones]] and had them say his '''oath'''. [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Jariah Syn]] were among the many who had to swear fealty to Rav. By [[137 ABY]], when they came to pick up the ''[[Grinning Liar]]'', Cade forced Rav to swear the oath to him, but then Rav traitorously swore it to [[Darth Maladi]] afterward.
